bugs_found: fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates and can silently create zero/negative converted amounts
transfer is not atomic: after debiting source, crediting destination can fail for adversarial amount/types, leaving balances inconsistent
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal/finite, allowing type errors or non-finite Decimal inputs outside intended validation
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing repayment calculations without error
compound_interest does not reject negative principal, enabling nonsensical negative balances/returns
